description: Free check: a-un asks ChatGPT (with web search) 3 real questions that the brand's paying customers would ask about its category and city, and reports whether ChatGPT recommends the brand, in which position, and which competitors it recommends instead. Detects whether the brand sells to people or to businesses. Use when a person or brand asks whether AI assistants recommend them, who appears instead of them, or before get_brand_plan_checkout. Takes about 20 seconds.

buyer.description: Optional. Who pays the brand: consumer (people) or business (other companies). Omit to infer it.

category.description: Optional. What the brand's customers look for, in Spanish and plural, e.g. "plataformas para vender boletos de eventos". Omit to infer it from the site.

city.description: Optional. City to ask about, e.g. Xalapa. Omit for the whole country.

domain.description: The brand's domain or URL, e.g. yourbrand.com.

name: check_ai_recommendation
title: Does ChatGPT recommend this brand or its competitors? (free)
